summary_1line: Arjuna confronts his son Vabhruvahana during the Ashvamedha quest, provoking a duel that ends with Arjuna struck down and both collapsing.

image_candidates.scene_text: Prince Vabhruvahana in golden armor raises a lion-bannered standard as he rides out to confront his father Arjuna guarding the sacrificial horse.
A sharp arrow from Vabhruvahana pierces Arjuna’s shoulder and drives into the earth as the great warrior staggers with his bow Gandiva in hand.
Arjuna collapses unconscious on the battlefield while his son Vabhruvahana, wounded and grief-stricken, also falls to the ground amid scattered arrows.
